sermons.title: Sermon 2169 | The Man Who Shall Never See Death

scripture.verse: "Verily, verily, Isay unto you, If a man keep My saying, he shall never see death. Then said the Jews unto Him, Now we know that You have a devil. Abraham is dead, and the Prophets, and You say, If a man keep My saying, he shall never taste of death. Are You greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the Prophets are dead: whom make You Yourself"

sermons.title: Sermon 2170 | The Blessing of the High Priest

scripture.verse: "And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying, Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons saying, On this wise you shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them, The Lord bless you, and keep you: the Lord make His face shine upon you, and be gracious unto you: the Lord lift up His Countenance upon you, and give you peace. And they shall put My name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them."

sermons.title: Sermon 2171 | Runaway Jonah and the Convenient Ship

scripture.verse: "But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish."

sermons.title: Sermon 2172 | Patient Job and the Baffled Enemy

scripture.verse: "In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly."

sermons.title: Sermon 2173 | Little Faith and Great Faith

scripture.verse: "O you of little faith, why did you doubt?"

"And He arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever, and they besought Him for her. And He stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them."
"Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know you it for your good."

sermons.title: Sermon 2176 | The Lord No More Angry with His People

scripture.verse: "For this is as the waters of Noah unto Me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be angry with you, nor rebuke you."

sermons.title: Sermon 2177 | Camp Law and Camp Life

scripture.verse: "For the Lord your God walks in the midst of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you, therefore shall your camp be holy that He sees no unclean thing in you, and turn away from you."
